name: Voz emotiva bilingue
description: Adult male voice, late thirties, bilingual native-level speaker of Castilian Spanish and American English. Deeply emotional and expressive: a voice full of feeling and wonder, tender and trembling on key words, dramatic rises and falls in pitch, breathy intimate moments and bursts of excitement, like an actor delivering a moving heartfelt movie monologue to a friend who has just seen something unbelievable. Warm rich mid-low timbre with a hint of playful charm. Clear articulation in both languages and natural English pronunciation of names like JARVIS. Not an announcer, not monotone, not robotic.
text: ¡No me lo puedo creer! Mira… solo una palmada… y todo cobra vida. Sin teclado, sin ratón. Es increíble, Tony. Honestly, it's beautiful. Even JARVIS would be jealous!
